title: A day as the agency admin

scenes.title: A day as the agency admin
scenes.subtitle: Ananya runs Sahyadri Holidays
scenes.narration: Meet Ananya. She owns Sahyadri Holidays and is the admin of its workspace. Here is her morning.
She signs in with her email and password to the agency's private workspace.
Her dashboard shows the day: new leads, follow-ups due, revenue for the month, and a Needs attention box with what the assistant has prepared.
The number beside Assistant in the sidebar counts suggestions waiting for someone. She opens the queue and clears two.
She posts an announcement, and everyone sees it in their notifications.
On the team page she sees who is active and in which role. There are six roles, each with fixed permissions: admin, sales manager, salesperson, operations, accountant and view only.
Billing shows the plan, the renewal date, how many of the included users are in use, and every subscription invoice.
Before lunch, a look at the team report: who is closing, and where the pipeline is stuck.

scenes.headline: Run the whole agency from one screen.
scenes.narration: TravelCRM Pro. Run the whole agency from one screen.
